meta.title: Project process manager
meta.description: Adds a Project processes button in the session header beside Commit. It lists only port-owning (TCP/UDP) processes of the current workspace, attributed by the workspace of the DSH session that launched each process rather than the process's own cwd. Click the button again to toggle the panel off. Clicking Stop sends SIGKILL immediately with no confirmation. Process discovery uses ps and lsof; only the authenticated local page can call the Host route.
